Hi Liam —

Thanks for the note and the report, this makes the spike clear. Two straightforward paths we typically use:

Option A — Immediate true-up (fastest):
- Add 20k reserved units today; billing pro-rated for the remainder of your current term.
- No change to your renewal date (co-term optional).
- If you opt to co-term the top-up to 2028-06-30 and sign an amendment, we can apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to ~8% of the first-month top-up cost (applies only if amendment signed within 10 business days).

Option B — Staged top-up + voucher (lower upfront):
- Stage 10k now + 10k in 60 days; vouchers applied to smooth invoice impact.
- If you commit to co-term at time of staged agreement we can extend a 12,000 USD onboarding credit and a locked-in blended rate for the remainder of the term.

I've attached a short SOW + two example invoice sketches (pro-rata vs staged) so procurement has numbers to feed the PO. If you prefer, we can do a short call Friday to walk procurement through the math.

Best,
Irene

[Attachment: procurement_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)]
